messages:
nina: Quick check on the upcoming "RefKit Starter" launch: we need final copy for the announcement post, webinar plan, and routing rules for signups. Goal: traffic -> tutorial repo + slack channel.

kevin: I can write the post + landing. Suggest hero language: "Start building with RefKit Starter in minutes" and keep hard numbers in a linked benchmark section.

olga: I'll run the demo and create the hands-on lab. Propose 20m demo + 25m guided lab in the webinar.

sam: For inbound routing, map signups to CRM with tag refkit-starter and post hot leads to #devrel-inbound. Simple webhook payload fields: email, company, role, interest.

kevin: I'll make the landing form match those fields and add an opt-in box for workshop followup.

devrel-bot: Channel #devrel-inbound-refkit-starter created and webhook URL posted.

nina: Timeline: landing copy ready by Sep 18, repo + lab by Sep 25, benchmark notebook by Sep 28, webinar week Oct 10. Everyone ok?

olga: Yep, starting the repo scaffold now.

kevin: Will draft post & CTA today and share for quick review.

sam: Great. I'll open a tiny tracker doc and assign owners.

nina: Thanks team ":thumbsup:"
